doc_name: Spring Rock Township, Clinton County, Iowa
text: Spring Rock Township is located in Clinton County, Iowa, United States. As of the 2000 census, the population of the township was 1,142. It was organized in 1844 and derives its name from a large rock found at a spring in Scott County. The township spans an area of 36.25 square miles (93.9 km²) and includes one incorporated settlement, Wheatland, as well as unincorporated settlements such as Big Rock. According to the U.S. Geological Survey, it contains four cemeteries: Homigrahusen, Pine Hill, Rose Hill, and Saint Pauls. The streams that flow through the township are Calamus Creek, Lizard Creek, Rock Creek, and Yankee Run. This article about the geography of Clinton County, Iowa is a stub.
